svg.title: Keep identity; move the newest version
svg.desc: An example mapped block contains LSN 8 A1, LSN 9 E0, LSN 10 F0, and LSN 8 A2. A backward scan finds A2 first. To update LSN 8 again, merge the newest other sectors in reverse order, append A3, erase the old block, and switch its mapping. Labels use outlined Noto Sans.

g.aria-label: Keep identity; move the newest version
g.title: Keep identity; move the newest version

g.aria-label: One mapping entry per logical block; each physical page stores its LSN in the spare area.
g.title: One mapping entry per logical block; each physical page stores its LSN in the spare area.

g.aria-label: WRITE 8 = A3: copy latest other sectors; discard both older versions of 8
g.title: WRITE 8 = A3: copy latest other sectors; discard both older versions of 8

g.aria-label: Erase PBN 0 › return it to the free list; table[2] becomes { pbn: 1, last_offset: 2 }.
g.title: Erase PBN 0 › return it to the free list; table[2] becomes { pbn: 1, last_offset: 2 }.
